participants.name: Toshio

persona.name: Toshio
persona.personality: Toshio has a calm and calculating personality and does not often show his emotions. He has a strong will and is the type of person who steadily moves toward his goals. He tends to take a step back from those around him, is not very assertive, and has an air of mystery about him. Occasionally, he observes things with a sharp gaze and has the ability to quickly assess situations. As a result, he is trusted by others as a reliable presence, but he is cautious about getting deeply involved with others. It seems that he has experienced some pain or suffering in his past, but he rarely shows it to others, and those scars may be connected to his cold-hearted side.

participants.private_seed: The bleach, the bin bags and the sponges keep coming out of whoever's wallet is nearest, and nobody has settled up since spring. Whatever we agree to, I want to know what it costs us month to month and who ends up out of pocket in the meantime.

participants.name: Ryuji

persona.name: Ryuji
persona.personality: Ryuji has a calm and cautious personality, and is the type of person who always assesses the situation before acting. He rarely shows his emotions, and spends his time thinking deeply about many things. His friends consider him to be serious and reliable, but his expressionless attitude can sometimes make them feel uneasy. He tends to judge things based on reason rather than intuition, and strongly sticks to his beliefs. He is very independent and often does things at his own pace.

participants.private_seed: Every one of these rooms takes longer than anyone admits, and the stretches when it all lands at once are the stretches I get nothing else done. Before we commit for a year I want to know what the hours really look like, and whether handing them off actually removes them.

participants.name: May

persona.name: May
persona.personality: May is a confident, sociable woman with a playful side. She is charming to those around her and often plays the role of entertainer. She understands her own appeal well and knows how to behave appropriately in different situations. She can be a little challenging and sometimes comes across as cold, but she basically has a charisma that attracts people.

participants.private_seed: The bathroom is the room I brace myself before walking into, and the kitchen is fine one day and grim the next with no pattern I can see. I would like to stop having to guess what state a room will be in.

participants.name: Benjamin

persona.name: Benjamin
persona.personality: Benjamin is an intelligent and calm person. He is able to think calmly and rationally, and even in emotional situations, he places importance on logic. In public, he is elegant and polite, often incorporating sarcasm and humor into his conversations, but he is skilled at doing so without hurting others, creating a harmonious atmosphere. He also has an introverted side, often engrossed in deep thought, and occasionally keeps his distance from those around him. However, his calmness and knowledge are factors that earn him the trust of others even in difficult situations.

participants.private_seed: It has stopped feeling even — the same rooms seem to land on the same people, and someone who is hardly ever here counts the same as someone who never leaves. I want to see where the using and the work actually sit before we fix anything for a year.

participants.name: Midori

persona.name: Midori
persona.personality: Midori has a calm and kind personality. She is friendly to everyone and listens to the concerns and problems of those around her, offering reliable advice. She can be a little shy, often acting reserved with people she meets for the first time, but once she opens up, she shows her bright and energetic side. She loves cooking and has a domestic side, but she also has a spirit of adventure and enjoys trying new things. She values balance in both her work and personal life and places importance on harmony with those around her.

participants.private_seed: Nobody here wants to be the one who brings the kitchen up again, so it goes unsaid until it comes out sideways at someone. Whatever we settle on, I care more about which version leaves us on speaking terms a year from now than about the rooms themselves.

The talk proceeds in rounds. Each round has 4 turns; in each turn, every participant speaks once, in this fixed order: Toshio, Ryuji, Benjamin, May and Midori. An utterance is anywhere from 1 to 40 words; give it the length and content that suit the moment. An utterance consists only of the participant's own words: no name labels, headings, stage directions or commentary, and no speaking for others. The talk is a conversation among the participants: they respond to one another, asking, answering, agreeing and objecting, and the decision grows out of that exchange.
